group.name: required
group.comment: All required libraries, built by default. Entire group can be disabled by '--no-thirdparty'. Individual libraries in the group can be disabled via --no-name flag, e.g. --no-python.

group.name: optional
group.comment: Optional libraries, the entire group is disabled by default, and can be enabled via --optional flag or. Individual libraries can be enabled via --name, e.g. --conduit.

group.name: explicit
group.comment: Libraries that can only be enabled individually, the group cannot be enabled as a whole. This list can include mutually exclusive libraries like 'mesgal' and 'osmesa', or libraries only needed on specific platforms, or libraries with problematic builds.
